name: claude_fast
_about: The models of the fast tool path (ADR-019, T-08.5): claude-haiku-4-5 on every step (the tool selector, the answer writer, and the clarification and answer checker a pause may run). Sonnet only if the quality fails on the fixed messages (Q11-9). Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Its own file so it can be tuned without touching claude_haiku.
